parchment.$description: Parchment — Page canvas, card surfaces, nav backgrounds — warm off-white that replaces pure white as the base layer everywhere

soft-paper.$description: Soft Paper — Slightly elevated card surface (one step above the canvas) — used on suggestion cards

warm-mist.$description: Warm Mist — Hairline card and input borders — warm gray that reads as a pencil line on parchment

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, secondary labels — warmer than #72706b

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav icons, secondary button text, inactive labels — the dominant neutral text color

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, icon fills, button backgrounds — deep warm-black (not pure #000) carries the brand's brownish undertone

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — High-contrast text and icon accents — used sparingly where maximum weight is needed

deep-teal.$description: Deep Teal — Active nav item background, selected state fill, brand-signaling accent — single chromatic color carrying all navigational emphasis

pplxsans.$description: Custom geometric sans used everywhere — body text at 16px/1.5 weight 400, UI labels at 14px/1.43, micro text at 11–12px weight 500. The narrow weight range (400–500) keeps the interface visually quiet; there is no bold display weight. Letter-spacing stays at 0 (normal) across all sizes.
